title: Progressive Performance (Chrome Dev Summit 2016)
summary: Alex Russell's Chrome Dev Summit 2016 talk on building web experiences that work on slow, flaky networks and low-power devices. It argues developers should focus on the performance of real-world mobile hardware rather than desktop machines.
why: HN commenters cite it as the clearest case for why mobile devices are slow and why code-splitting and progressive web apps are needed.

quote.text: Take a look at this talk on why mobile devices are so much slower than desktop devices
